name: Altispex
tagline: Certified aerial inspections, without the crew or the guesswork.
positioning: Altispex turns a single consumer drone into an audit-grade inspection suite — guided flights, defect detection, and signed PDF reports.

hero.h1: Inspect any roof, tower, or facade like a licensed firm.
hero.sub: Altispex plans the flight, captures every angle, flags the defects, and hands you a stamped inspection report — all from the drone already sitting in your garage.

features.title: Guided flight plans
features.description: Draw your structure and Altispex generates a compliant, overlap-perfect flight path so you capture inspection-grade imagery on the first pass.

features.title: Automated defect detection
features.description: Our vision models flag cracked shingles, corrosion, delamination, and missing fasteners, then rank each finding by severity and repair urgency.

features.title: Signed PDF reports
features.description: Every inspection compiles into a timestamped, geotagged report you can hand to clients, insurers, or adjusters with confidence.

features.title: Airspace compliance
features.description: Live LAANC checks and no-fly overlays keep every mission inside the rules before your props ever spin.

features.title: Change tracking
features.description: Re-fly a site months later and Altispex overlays the results, surfacing exactly what degraded since your last visit.

features.title: Shareable client portals
features.description: Give homeowners and property managers a clean, branded view of findings, photos, and recommended next steps.

testimonials.quote: I quoted three roof jobs in a morning without climbing a single ladder. The stamped report closed every one of them on the spot.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delroy

testimonials.quote: As a solo home inspector, Altispex gave me the polish of a firm ten times my size. Adjusters take my reports seriously now.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

testimonials.quote: The defect ranking caught corrosion on a cell tower flange I would have flown right past. It paid for itself the first week.
testimonials.name: Tobias Reinhardt
